2610.05264.title: Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation for Efficient Audio Deepfake Detection
2610.05264.paper_summary: Advances in speech synthesis have made deepfake speeches increasingly convincing, posing growing threats to security. While self-supervised learning (SSL) based detectors achieve state-of-the-art performance, their computational demands (typically 300M+ parameters) prevent deployment on resource-constrained devices. Existing compression methods, designed mainly for content-centric tasks, struggle to maintain competitive performance when directly adapted to deepfake detection. We propose a Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation framework that combines cross-domain knowledge distillation with movement-guided structured pruning to transfer forgery-discriminative knowledge and preserve critical structures under aggressive compression. Our framework reduces the model to 31.9M parameters with 6.3$\times$ FLOPs reduction, with an average performance drop of only 1.30\% across multiple datasets compared to the uncompressed baseline, demonstrating strong potential for on-device deployment.
2610.05264.paper_summary_zh: 語音合成的進展使得深偽演講越來越具說服力，對安全構成日益增長的威脅。雖然基於自我監督學習（SSL）的檢測器達到了最先進的性能，但其計算需求（通常超過300M參數）使得在資源受限的設備上無法部署。現有的壓縮方法主要為內容中心任務設計，當直接應用於深偽檢測時，難以保持競爭力的性能。我們提出了一種任務感知的聯合剪枝和蒸餾框架，將跨領域知識蒸餾與運動引導的結構剪枝相結合，以轉移偽造區分知識並在激進壓縮下保留關鍵結構。我們的框架將模型減少到31.9M參數，並實現6.3$\times$的FLOPs減少，與未壓縮基準相比，平均性能下降僅為1.30\%，顯示出在設備上部署的強大潛力。
